scope: Read-only offline audit of the frozen GLM artifact; no new model runs, no production report replacement.
audit_method: Independent Python parsing and arithmetic over native OpenCode, ATIF, wrapper session, wire request/response, and ZG sidecar artifacts. Earliest source entry independently re-matched without calling e2e_analysis.py.

definitions.primary_input: Native OpenCode input + cache.read; equals ATIF final and main QA wire prompt_tokens. Cache writes separate and zero in this artifact.
definitions.output: OpenCode output excludes reasoning; provider completion_tokens includes it. Native output + reasoning agrees with provider main QA completion.
definitions.tool_counts: All observed native tool attempts, cross-checked against ATIF/session/report; all 136 completed in this run.
definitions.first_entry: At least one frozen primary function entry. Exact path plus visible numbered definition, or exact standalone function outline and entry address. No hidden raw content or containing-parent inference.
definitions.phase_boundary: Discovery includes the first useful result and the whole requesting model turn. Later tool events are expansion even when requested in the same parallel batch; event boundary does not imply a later decision caused by seeing evidence.
definitions.empty_grep: Successful native grep with metadata.matches=0 or explicit no-results output. Different failed guesses are not exact repeated-query strings.
definitions.annotation_scope: Development source annotations, not held-out or exhaustive official relevance labels.

weak_wins.definition: Observed input reductions below 1%; descriptive threshold, not a significance test.

limitations: Five repeats are one development case, not five independent QA tasks; cannot establish cross-task efficacy or quality non-inferiority.
All five input differences favor ZG, but blocks1 and4 are weak gains and blocks3 and5 account for about91.6% of total savings; magnitude remains variable.
Each ZG trial used the same first query text; block4 requested limit15 while the others used the default, so the E2E searches are not identical executions.
Title generation uses temperature0.5 and is outside main ATIF usage; provider-all totals separately include it. Main QA requests use temperature0.
Input tokens include cache hits and are not dollar cost.
Integrity claims are checked against preserved CI result and verification records; source/index bytes were not re-executed or freshly queried in this audit.
No separate quality reassessment was performed; quality and retrieval are audited by another reviewer.
